description: Gaming energy drink brand founded in 2012 selling sugar-free energy formula tubs, ready-to-drink cans and hydration products aimed at gamers and streamers. Runs a large creator affiliate program on GoAffPro with a public ambassador application page.

evidence.summary: G Fuel's official Ambassador page invites content creators to apply: affiliates receive a personal code giving fans 20% off at GFUEL.com and earn commission on every sale, paid via PayPal, plus free product, merch and early flavor access. Applicants must be 18+. Program questions go to ambassadors@gfuel.com. The page confirms commission is paid but does not publish the percentage.

The Affiliate Monkey's program review states the G Fuel affiliate program is managed through the GoAffPro platform and pays a 10% commission on qualified transactions, paid monthly via PayPal. The brand's own page does not publish the rate, so 10% is recorded as publicly reported.

GoAffPro's own case study confirms G Fuel runs its affiliate program on GoAffPro (portal at affiliates.gfuel.com) with 1100+ affiliates generating eight figures in referral revenue. An affiliate count above 1,100 is far above the ~100-creator scale required for a 'low' saturation mark, so creator_saturation is unknown.
